---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for Trueshift
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.
Ex: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case
Explain how you would use this feature in your workflow.

## Additional Context
- Screenshots or mockups if applicable
- Links to related features in other tools
- Any research or references that support this feature

## Alignment with Trueshift Philosophy
How does this feature align with Trueshift's goals of:
- [ ] Circadian health optimization
- [ ] Simplicity and ease of use
- [ ] Following Jack Kruse/blue light research
- [ ] Work compression ("Finish Line" concept)
